name: WE_SHC_3671209
description: Wurth Elektronik WE-SHC two-piece board-level shielding cabinet, COVER part 3671209 -- the COMPACT variant of the 3670375/3671375 pair, adopted 2026-08-16 for the 30 x 70 mm respin. Land 22.2 x 16.6 mm against the 3670375's 38.7 x 30.5 mm, saving 812 mm^2 -- the single biggest area win available without changing the BOM's function. Same WE-SHC two-piece Faraday family, so the EMI tier is unchanged.
verification: MECHANICAL / NO-SCHEMATIC-SIGNAL PART. Dimensions VERIFIED from the local copy of the 3671209 datasheet: inner 20.9 x 15.3 mm, outer 21.3 x 15.7 mm, height 1.7 mm ref.. Intentionally has NO footprint: the cover clips onto the frame and is not soldered, so its datasheet publishes no land pattern. Placed on the schematic as BOM-only, excluded from the board -- same treatment as the 3671375 cover and the BT1-BT6 cells. Pairs with FRAME 3670209.
